drivers.fact: Reuters reported that U.S. forces struck two Iranian launchers on Larak Island on 30 August; AP and CNBC reported higher crude and weaker broad U.S. equity indices in the 31 August session.

The 11-sector ETF proxy showed 18.2% positive one-day breadth; Energy was the only positive sector ETF among the daily proxy basket.
